description: "Research programs at the Tuck Lab"

Our research brings together human genetic variation, molecular profiling, and experimental systems to understand cardiac disease.

## Cardiac genetics and arrhythmia

We investigate how inherited variants influence cardiac biology, including cell-type-specific gene regulation, chromatin interactions, and mechanisms contributing to arrhythmia risk.

## Heart failure and human tissue genomics

We study human cardiac tissue to identify molecular programs associated with heart failure and cardiometabolic disease. Single-nucleus and spatial approaches help resolve the distinct contributions of cardiomyocytes and non-myocyte populations.

## Functional genomics and disease mechanisms

We use genome perturbation, long-read sequencing, and human cellular models to test causal hypotheses, including how RNA processing and regulatory variation influence disease phenotypes.
